source.statement: Regenerated for the warehouse capability read projection (eiams-frontend-lvtk.1): GET /api/v1/warehouses/{warehouseId}/capabilities now returns each capability with its granted operations inline, so a consumer no longer needs 1+N calls to assemble the capability matrix. The change is additive - one new required string array on Application.WarehouseCapabilities.GetByWarehouse.WarehouseCapabilityResponse - and the regenerated snapshot diff is exactly those 7 lines, with no drift in any other path or schema. Capability reads have no status filter, so Inactive (revoked) capabilities still appear and are distinguished by the existing status field; this is unchanged behaviour and is documented rather than narrowed. Also corrects a stale checksum: the sha256 recorded here did not match the snapshot it accompanied (recorded 65489bc6..., actual 1f689e9c...), and no test enforces this field, so it had drifted silently. It is now the real hash of this file, computed over the raw bytes.
